Shiny render function for roughViz

Source: R/roughViz.R
renderRoughViz.Rd

Shiny render function for roughViz

Usage

renderRoughViz(expr, env = parent.frame(), quoted = FALSE)

Arguments

expr

Expression that returns a roughViz widget.

env

Environment in which to evaluate `expr`.

quoted

Should the expression be treated as quoted? Set to `TRUE` when calling from another function.

Value

A server-side function suitable for use inside `output$<id> <-`.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
  server <- function(input, output, session) {
    output$sales_plot <- renderRoughViz({
      roughBar(
        data = data.frame(
          labels = c("A", "B", "C"),
          values = c(3, 5, 2)
        ),
        labels = "labels",
        values = "values"
      )
    })
  }
} # }
